# Paths that exist identically in both chain repos (stellar, solana).
#
# A pull request that touches any of these must carry the `shared` label, so
# sync.yml carries it to the sibling repo when it merges — or the
# `chain-only` label, to say on purpose that it must not. shared-label.yml
# enforces that; sync.yml does the carrying.
#
# One prefix per line, matched against the start of each changed file's path.
# Keep this file the same in both repos: it is itself a shared path.

packages/trust/
apps/web/lib/agent/
